title: fix: stop the community monitor storing Discord message text
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: The community monitor now runs cycles with --no-session-persistence, discards cycle output, and clears Discord MCP debug logs after each cycle so they do not retain Discord message text. loop.log keeps only start and end times and exit status; failed cycles still return a non-zero exit. Existing logs and transcripts on the box were manually deleted on 2026-10-12.

Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny caretaker's cap and is small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements, never oversized or dominating the image, strictly pixel art style, never realistic; soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
